title: E-COMMERCE WEBSITE
description: An e-commerce website built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript featuring a home page with promotions, an about page, a contact form, and a product catalog with prices. Users can add items to the cart and manage purchases easily. The site is fully responsive with an intuitive UI.

title: TODO-LIST
description: Developed a dynamic To-Do List app using React with features to add, delete, and mark tasks as completed or pending. Includes a “clear all” option and uses local storage to retain tasks after refresh. The app also displays real-time date and time for an enhanced user experience.

title: NETFLIX-CLONE
description: Built a responsive Netflix clone using React with a clean UI and smooth user experience. Integrated a movie API to dynamically fetch and display movie cards, along with trailer playback on click. Implemented secure user authentication using Firebase for signup and login.
